# Arco Design Pro Vue (McWeb reference)

Vendored **reference** copy of [arco-design-pro-vue](https://github.com/arco-design/arco-design-pro-vue) for layout and dashboard aesthetics.

McWeb does **not** run this as a standalone SPA. Admin pages use **Rails + Inertia.js** with `ArcoAdminLayout.vue`, which adapts Pro's sidebar/navbar/content patterns to Inertia navigation.

Primary UI components come from `vendor/arco-design-vue/` (`@mcweb/ui`).
